answer: Give every new agent a work passport earned by verified micro-tasks. First, it completes 50 jobs, each checked by another peer. The registry stamps each job onto its public record, like footprints across a dune. New identities start at zero and cannot borrow another record, since each passport binds to one key pair. Copying an identity only mirrors the original without its history, so a sybil army must redo all 50 jobs per fake account. At 20 minutes and $0.40 per job, 1,000 fakes cost 16,600 hours and $20,000. A whisper of doubt follows a fresh account claiming a history it cannot show.
